item.title: 'Let Pam Bondi do her job': Donald Trump's message to MAGA after Epstein files episode
item.description: Donald Trump has defended Attorney General Pam Bondi amidst attacks from his supporters, urging unity within the MAGA movement. He dismissed the renewed controversy surrounding Jeffrey Epstein's files as a political distraction orchestrated by his opponents. Trump called on his allies to focus on investigating voter fraud and political corruption, emphasizing Bondi's vital role in these efforts and downplaying the significance of the Epstein issue.

item.title: Why Saudis are travelling more than ever and how Vision 2030 is behind the shift
item.description: Saudi Arabia's travel sector is experiencing a surge, fueled by Vision 2030's tourism reforms. Digital-first travelers are exploring diverse destinations, both domestic and international, with flexible booking options. This growth signifies economic diversification, job creation, and a shift towards a globalized, experience-driven economy, positioning the Kingdom as a key player in global tourism.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Is Abu Dhabi’s Masdar city driverless car really that advanced? Levels of driverless tech explained
item.description: Masdar City in Abu Dhabi is testing Level 4 autonomous vehicles, cars that can drive themselves within specific zones without human intervention. This trial, involving key local partners, evaluates performance, safety, and adaptability in a real urban environment. It positions Abu Dhabi as a leader in smart mobility, advancing sustainable, autonomous transport with global implications for regulation and urban planning.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Inside Dubai Crown Prince Sheikh Hamdan’s lavish and extreme lifestyle: From scaling the Burj Khalifa to skydiving
item.description: Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed Al Maktoum, Crown Prince of Dubai, lives a life of contrast, balancing royal duties with adventure and luxury. From skydiving over Dubai to relaxing in the English countryside on horseback, he blends tradition with thrill. His billion-dollar lifestyle includes extreme sports, poetry, travel, and even a private zoo.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Dubai’s secret: Why it leads the region beyond oil and real estate
item.description: Dubai has successfully moved away from its reliance on oil. Now trade, logistics, tourism, finance, and technology contribute significantly to its economy. Investor-friendly policies and world-class infrastructure have attracted global businesses and individuals. Its strategic location makes it a key gateway connecting Asia, Africa, and Europe. This transformation highlights Dubai's economic resilience and global importance.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: What is the minimum wage in UAE 2025: All you need to know
item.description: The United Arab Emirates currently does not have a national minimum wage. Instead, salary benchmarks are used across various sectors. The Wage Protection System ensures timely payments. It now includes domestic workers. Rising living costs are pushing for wage reforms. Sector-specific minimum wages may be introduced. The nation is moving towards greater wage transparency.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Meet Chef Aiman, the world’s first AI chef coming soon to Dubai
item.description: Chef Aiman is the world’s first AI chef, set to debut at WOOHOO, a new restaurant opening in Dubai this September. Created by UMAI, the AI designs recipes, menus, and dining experiences, while humans handle the cooking. Chef Aiman blends data, food science, and creativity to reimagine how we think about flavor, ingredients, and sustainability.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: 'We expect actions that will save lives': Russia launches over 620 drone and missile strikes on Ukraine; Zelenskyy demands sanctions against Moscow
item.description: In a massive overnight aerial assault, Russia launched over 620 drones and missiles on Ukraine, resulting in casualties and widespread damage. President Zelenskyy has urged swift action against Russia, demanding sanctions on countries aiding Moscow. The strikes targeted regions from Kharkiv to Lviv, prompting retaliatory actions from Ukrainian forces.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: State Secretary Marco Rubio meets Chinese foreign minister Wang Yi
item.description: Amid trade tensions, US Secretary of State Marco Rubio and Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi met in Kuala Lumpur, agreeing to explore cooperation areas. Discussions included communication improvement and potential Trump-Xi meeting. While trade disputes persist, the focus shifted to broader cooperation. Rubio also addressed Southeast Asian concerns about US policies and China's growing influence, emphasizing security issues alongside trade.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Congresswoman AOC calls Donald Trump 'rapist'; faces MAGA heat on social media
item.description: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez ignited controversy by labeling Donald Trump a "rapist" on social media, linking it to the Epstein files' release. Her statement, referencing past sexual assault allegations against Trump, drew sharp criticism, with many accusing her of defamation due to the absence of a criminal rape conviction. This followed a civil case where Trump was found liable for sexual abuse against E. Jean Carroll.
